evidenceClassRule: Every run below carries SYNTHETIC_TIER_ENTRY and NON_CANONICAL_REWARD_MULTIPLIER. Progression integrity and combat sanity only; never economy pacing.

experiments.hypothesis: Templates derived from the canonical T1 routes describe characters the game could produce.
experiments.finding: All 12 templates owned the four Clearing starter items while declaring no clearing biome level, so those recipes never unlocked.
experiments.fix: Added clearing: 4 to the template manifest. Excluded from globalMastery(), so no rune budget or upgrade ceiling changed.

experiments.hypothesis: applyTierEntryProfile produces exactly the declared character with no stale combat state.
experiments.finding: Striker, Squire, Apprentice, Slinger, Spirit all PASS; 212-221 combined offline+live checks each, 0 errors.

experiments.hypothesis: A targeting preference orders enemies already in the fight; it does not choose which fight to start.
experiments.control: focus-closest in the same scene; the same scene out of combat
experiments.finding: In Combat -> Focus Highest HP selected a 4,000 HP unengaged monster 3,200px away over the wolf attacking the player. Cause: distance weight 0.001 against a raw-maxHp score, with the acquire radius raised to 10,000 by Find Enemies. Separately, focus-lowest-hp scored 1/hp and inverted into focus-nearest at large HP scales.
experiments.fix: HP-preference modes choose from the engaged set while anything is engaged, and score a normalized 0..1 term. focus-elites deliberately excluded.
experiments.nextSuggested: Designer call on whether focus-elites may still start a fight across the node.

experiments.hypothesis: Tier-2 items are crafted the way Tier-1 items are.
experiments.finding: 20 of 32 T2 recipes are evolutions and craftRecipe refuses them. Evolution needs the predecessor in the BAG at +5. Across six class plans: 7 evolve, 15 evolve-after-unequip, 22 reconstruct (~3.5x cost), 6 plain craft, 0 unreachable.
experiments.rootCause: EVOLUTION_REQUIRED_PLUS moved 3 -> 5 on 2026-08-29; the canonical T1 routes were never updated and leave most lineages below +5.
experiments.fix: Added an unequip route step and a per-item acquisition planner resolved from each class's own template. The +5 shortfall was NOT routed around.

experiments.hypothesis: The control route progresses through its first biome leg.
experiments.finding: Blocked 521 of 540 seconds on reconstruct:plains-charm-t2 needing 2 alacrity catalysts, while parked in node-t2-plains-04 (dominion) holding 46,044 spare yellow and 5 unspendable dominion catalysts.
experiments.fix: t2FarmFor(group, family): cost-farms prefer a node whose modifier mints the required family.

experiments.finding: Plains leg completed: evolve vest, reconstruct charm (298s, down from never), unequip+evolve boots, recorded steelsword skip, maxed Plains to 12, three opportunistic upgrades correctly resolving to +0 (the T2 ceiling is +0 below GM 42).

The dev reward multiplier deliberately does not scale catalyst progress, so catalysts mint at 1x in every run. Measured: 2 alacrity in 298s at 100x. Total T2 demand derived live: alacrity 40, swarming 17, fortified 17, heavy 16, dominion 9 = 99, on the order of four hours of irreducible waiting per full-tier run.
experiments.consequence: An accelerated T2 run is catalyst-bound rather than combat-bound.
experiments.response: Added the catalyst-primed entry-economy arm: zero essence plus the full derived T2 catalyst demand. Progression-integrity instrument only; never economy evidence.

experiments.finding: Plains leg finished in ~35s (vs ~300s). Two deaths to the Plains T2 boss (gorging-razortusk), largest hit 61 into a 183 HP pool = three hits to kill; boss left at 91.7% both times.
experiments.interpretation: One class, one branch, non-canonical, synthetic template, fighting the Plains T2 boss with a TIER-1 weapon (chaotic-axe +5) because the control route fights each boss at the end of its own leg. Consistent with the designer's report that T2 numbers are out, but cannot distinguish boss-too-strong from route-fights-too-early from build-has-no-T2-weapon.
experiments.nextSuggested: Same boss from a build already holding a T2 weapon; separately with the boss step moved to the end of the tier. One variable each.

experiments.finding: Terminated by the environment at ~2 minutes. All five templates validated live; four of five had already evolved plains-vest-t2. Uncontrolled parallel put all five bots in the same node (contention recorded) - fine as a pipeline check, useless as comparative evidence.
experiments.nextSuggested: Admit the T2 routes to the controlled-batch registry so isolated-parallel area leases are available, then re-run to completion.

openHypotheses.statement: ruinous-axe is universally dominant: 43 atk x 1.20 aps = 51.6 naive DPS (38.7 after its dead swing) against 25.9 for the next best.
openHypotheses.matters: If true, five of the seven T2 weapons are decoration.

openHypotheses.statement: knight-steelsword (18 atk @ 1.0 aps) is worse than the T1 weapon every canonical route already ends on; all six class plans skip it.
openHypotheses.matters: The tier's opening weapon may be dead on arrival.

openHypotheses.statement: Desert mobility boots (58 speed, mobility.kite-speed-pct) are an extreme effective-defence multiplier against melee-heavy Cave.
openHypotheses.matters: Highest-value single equipment experiment; needs mid-tier checkpoints.

openHypotheses.statement: Conduit prefers slow high-attack weapons. Minion DPS is proportional to owner.attack x owner.APS (speed-neutral); flat plating breaks the tie toward slow, and onHitDamage is not inherited at all.
openHypotheses.matters: Determines whether Mountain or Cave is Conduit's biome. Derived from code, not yet measured in play.

openHypotheses.statement: Mountain and Jungle armour have no natural adopter (1/6 and 0/6 in the plans).
openHypotheses.matters: Two of seven armour identities may be inert.

openHypotheses.statement: The +5 evolution gate, not Tier-2 costs, is what makes Tier-2 gear expensive: 22 of 50 acquisitions pay ~3.5x because of a Tier-1 upgrade shortfall.
openHypotheses.matters: Changes whether the fix is a T1 route change or a T2 cost change.
